trace_extraction: Re-run exact frozen TUNE-01-load; at each Safety tick use most recent already-issued PLC ActuatorCommand before tick and latest released MeasuredSnapshot. Restrict causal root-cause comparison to pre-first-FAULT prefix, since failed post-FAULT command lineage was not persisted. Store source command ID/value/created_ns, measurement ID/sample_ns/available_ns/quality/age and existing Safety state. Raw ACTUAL and plant truth only in separate forensic artifact, never qualifier input.
offline_replay: Feed immutable trace rows as ReleasedObservation to frozen CumulativeTrackingQualifier(profile,R5.2 classifier) with no interpolation or resampling; compare state/epoch/watch/anchor/net demand/response-open/progress/suspicion/confirmation at every row.
production_reconstruction: Use failed-trial evidence, recorded previous-turn patch and frozen source; if exact failed source or exact released trace cannot be established, mark missing pieces and do not infer equivalence from a conceptual copy.
first_divergence: Find earliest unequal comparable field on exact common-prefix ticks; report time, field, offline and production values with a ±2.0s bounded window. If production tick records unavailable, first divergence is UNDETERMINED rather than guessed.
domain_checks: command and released measured speed within frozen speed_min/speed_max
sensor period/release delay/max age equal frozen profile
repeatability: At least 10 identical offline replays of same trace; compare state/epoch/watch/anchor/timestamps/result SHA
prefix_causality: Every prefix replay equals the corresponding prefix of full replay; future observations cannot affect past outputs
